answer_1.quote: We train a T5-11B model for scene elaboration, DREAM, starting with the Macaw checkpoint and by using the Scene Elaborations Dataset (Section 4.1).
answer_1.outputs: scene elaborations in the form of a 4-tuple {M, E, ROT, Con} with textual descriptions along dimensions of motivation, emotion, rule of thumb, and consequence

answer_4.quote: We use human evaluation using (mechanical Turk) crowdworkers.
answer_4.guideline: Workers rate each of the four components of the scene elaboration along 2 dimensions: SE accuracy and SE usefulness. In addition, workers rate the complete SE along the dimension of SE consistency.
